rows.grounds: optative of yuj; imperative sense in ritual instruction
ablative or indeclinable adverb; sequential order

items.question: How should the outer-cell dwellers be joined according to the previously stated rule?
items.inference: Therefore join the outer-cell dwellers by the previously stated rule in order.
uncertainties: Exact referent of outer-cell dwellers is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: Join the outer-cell dwellers by the previously stated rule, in order.
